pages.title: Domesticated Animals Get Hungry
pages.text: Once you feed an animal, it becomes domesticated and starts consuming hunger over time.$(br2)Offspring of domesticated animals are domesticated from birth; babies that spawn naturally in the wild stay wild - $(bold)wild babies never burn hunger and never starve$().$(br2)Hunger drains each in-game day based on the configured percentage (default 50% per day). Pregnant animals burn hunger 1.5x faster.

pages.title: Feeding Restores Hunger
pages.text: Right-click a hungry animal with food to restore hunger. Different foods restore different amounts. If hunger reaches zero, the animal enters a starving state and slowly loses health over 3 days — feed it quickly to save it!

pages.title: Why Keep Them Full
pages.text: An injured animal fed past 80% hunger slowly heals; a starving one gives off clear signs, and Jade will show a starving status directly.$(br2)Wild animals and wild babies never burn hunger - only domesticated animals need regular care.$(br2)When you are busy, set up a $(l:animalflee:hunger/trough)feeding trough$() and they will help themselves.

pages.title: Size Sets Health and Appetite
pages.text: Bigger animals have $(bold)more max health and a bigger stomach$(). A cow is the reference: an adult cow has 40 health and about 20 max hunger.$(br2)Within the same species, males are sturdier than females and eat a little more.$(br2)$(bold)Babies start at a quarter of the adult values$() - a calf about 10 health, a chick only 4. Both climb toward the adult numbers as the body grows.$(br2)Small animals are not hungrier: their drain scales down with their stomach.

pages.title: Hold Their Food and They Follow
pages.text: Domesticated animals know their food. Hold a $(bold)feed that matches their diet$() - crops or hay for herbivores, meat or fish for carnivores - and any domesticated animal within 10 blocks walks over and stops about two blocks away.$(br2)Wild animals and wild-born babies $(bold)ignore you$() - they are not domesticated yet.$(br2)An animal in courtship will not follow either; let it finish finding its mate.$(br2)They follow whether or not they are hungry, so a full animal still comes over.
